title: Chapter 1: It Seems the Duchess is Coming to Marry 4
content: “Alicia-sama, the young master tends to do unpredictable things when his emotions run high, so I would appreciate it if you could keep a tight leash on him.”
“Hey, Sebas, don’t you think that’s a bit rude to say about me?”
“I do think so.”
“Hey!”
If he thought about it before saying it, that made it even worse.
“Furthermore, since he’s been neglecting his studies under the guise of paperwork, I would be grateful if you could help him with that as well.”
“No, that’s not true, is it?”
On the contrary, I had a solid grasp of reading, writing, and arithmetic thanks to my modern education, and I was considered a prodigy even within the Brave Family.
There was no way I would be doing calculus in this other world; it wasn’t necessary.
Well, I didn’t actually know for sure, but it seemed unnecessary.
Especially since I had been drilled in combat skills and magical knowledge, I was confident enough to say that I was unmatched in those areas.
I had also studied history and geography thoroughly, as I intended to become an adventurer and travel the world someday.
As I was feeling dissatisfied, Sebas whispered to me.
“Young master, since you have the chance to spend time together, why not use it as an opportunity to review your studies?”
“I see, I understand.”
In other words, it was a plan to deepen our relationship through study sessions.
My heart fluttered at this development, which was typical of a romantic comedy.
Not to mention, since she was my fiancée and we were living under the same roof, she was more like a wife than just a girlfriend.
Wow, this other world isn’t so bad after all!
All the anxieties I had initially felt seemed to fade away, and I felt like life was becoming more enjoyable than I had expected.
“Next, let me borrow that.”
“Ah, yes.”
As I was internally giddy, Alicia, having finished processing a mountain of paperwork, snatched a large portion of my work away.
There were a lot of tasks like verifying numbers and copying documents, but she was clearing them away at an incredible speed.
“Wow…”
“Indeed, young master, you can’t afford to lose to her.”
Encouraged by Sebas, I decided to move my hands as well.
If I lost here, it would be a disgrace for someone who had completed modern basic education!
Ever since Alicia started helping with the work, our progress had been astonishing.
What I used to take a whole day to finish, she completed in just the morning, which meant we had more time to spend together in the afternoon.
Although it was called work, the really important tasks were handled by Sebas, while Alicia and I focused on checking the details of the documents.
I had prided myself on being good with numbers in the Brave Family, but Alicia was even better.
I was like a frog in a well, realizing the defeat of modern basic education.
If there were staff who created this world, I would want to tell them to make it a world where I could dominate even more with modern knowledge.
Thanks to that, the hierarchy in the mansion was now Sebas, Alicia, and then me.
If I was dissatisfied, I would have to complete paperwork faster than Alicia, but since I couldn’t win, I decided to accept being under her thumb.
“Well then, Laguna, I’ll go help clean the mansion staff.”
The sight of her rolling up her sleeves in work clothes was hardly what one would expect from a duchess.
As I watched her go, Sebas murmured.
“She is truly capable; it’s no wonder she was called a talented woman.”
“Of course.”
It was a result of the gifted education she had received since childhood, and she was simply diligent enough to endure the rigorous training.
Once she switched her mindset, she had the potential to thrive anywhere.
Even in the game, she would take over the Brave Family, make a contract with a demon, and do everything in her power to interfere with the protagonists' love lives.
“You’re lucky, young master.”
“Yeah, I really am…”
I wholeheartedly agreed with Sebas’s words.
The never-ending battle with paperwork was honestly more painful than killing enemy soldiers.
I was truly glad to see her talents and initiative being put to good use.

“Until now, the ladies of the house didn’t help at all and weren’t even present, so the staff is a bit bewildered, but no one feels bad about it; in fact, they seem to be more fond of you than of the young master.”
“...Was there any need to add ‘more than the young master’? Huh?”
“Well, let’s work hard to regain your trust, young master. I’ve taken it upon myself to keep some of the work aside to ensure you don’t slack off.”
“You really are a demon, aren’t you? Oh, by the way, isn’t the price at this weapon shop a bit too high?”
As I sighed while looking over the documents, I noticed a report about the opening of a newly established weapon shop, and their prices were unusually high compared to other shops.
Honestly, if they tried to rip off customers in Brave Territory, they wouldn’t last long; were they newcomers?
“Hmm, it seems they opened the weapon shop on the day Alicia-sama arrived?”
Sebas stroked his beard as he spoke.
The timing of Alicia’s arrival was too suspicious.
“Sebas, I assume you’ve already looked into where they came from?”
“Yes, they are from the Royal Capital.”
“Just as I thought.”
Upon further inquiry, it seemed they were peddling goods that were supposedly of high quality from the Royal Capital, taking advantage of the local nobility.
If the goods were genuinely good, that would be one thing, but judging by the flow of money, they didn’t seem that impressive.
In a land rife with battles, where professionals faced off against monsters, the quality of swords wasn’t all that significant.
After all, they were consumables, right?
What mattered more was the daily maintenance.
Swords would naturally wear down and become unusable if used and sharpened every day, so we were buying them second-hand in bulk, and there was no way such a high-end service would succeed here.

“Besides, I don’t understand why they would come all the way from the crowded Royal Capital to do business in Brave Territory. Their real aim is probably to keep an eye on Alicia, right? Do they intend to cause harm?”
“Adventurers have reported seeing them sneaking around at night. They were apparently frustrated with the high prices and attempted to steal something, but were spotted snooping around instead.”
“Talk about being too quick to act! Both sides are outrageous.”
Well, adventurers aren’t necessarily good people, so it’s only natural that they would end up in this situation if they attracted attention.
The Brave Family has a history of taking on dangerous roles, which is why we are respected by the roughnecks and maintain our relationships.
“I don’t know what their intentions are, but one of the adventurers who reported to us said that there was a skilled fighter among them, and he lost an arm.”
“Oh…”
Adventurers who engage in reckless behavior are usually weak, but they are still stronger than those from other lands.
For someone to take an arm from a roughneck who has survived in Brave Territory as an adventurer is a sign of strength.
“What will you do, young master?”
Normally, it would be Sebas who would throw out the ominous words first, and I would be the one to rein him in, but his question was a signal that he was giving me the freedom to act as I pleased.
“I’ll take care of it.”
Even if their intentions weren’t malicious and they were just monitoring, Alicia was now part of the Brave Family, so it was best to eliminate anyone snooping around.
“Then I’ll investigate their movements by night.”
“Leave it to me.”
“Should we give something to the adventurer who reported this?”
“That’s his own fault, isn’t it?”
There’s no mercy for an adventurer who carelessly poked a hornet’s nest.
He’s going to die anyway, so it would be pointless to help him.
“Understood.”
“By the way, Sebas, I have a favor to ask.”
“What is it?”
“When we go to the academy, can you find a way to keep Alicia close by?”
Soon, we would have to leave Brave Territory and attend the academy in the Royal Capital.
Since it was primarily a boarding school, both she and I would have to stay in the dorms, which meant there might be situations where I couldn’t protect her.
“Are you suggesting living under the same roof? I don’t mind, but I think it might be a bit challenging for you to balance that with your studies if you become pregnant while still a student.”
“N-No! That’s not what I meant!”
What was he even suggesting? We weren’t at that stage yet.
I didn’t want to become a beast of the Brave Family.
“I just want her to be within a range I can protect! There’s a possibility she’s already being targeted, and it would be too late if something happened!”
“The academy’s security… well, it’s not perfect, but there are many people around, so I doubt anyone would try to do anything conspicuous.”
“Just to be safe. Well, if there’s no way around it, then that’s fine.”
The girls’ and boys’ dorms were separated, and for high-ranking nobles, there were even designated areas.
Although Alicia was with the Brave Family, she was of a ducal lineage, and if she entered the area for high-ranking nobles, it would become difficult to protect her.
By the way, the Brave Family’s title is high enough to be able to marry into a ducal family, but we are treated like lower nobility due to discrimination.
It’s a harsh reality, but it’s just how the setting is.
“Well, before that, let’s deal with the weapon shop that came from the Royal Capital.”
Before heading to the academy, let’s take care of this little issue first.

“──I couldn’t see the sword’s trajectory at all. No, I didn’t even have a sword drawn. But suddenly, my right arm felt unusually light, and when I looked, my arm was lying on the ground. I messed up big time.”
As I walked down the dark road at midnight, I recalled the words of the adventurer who had lost his arm.
The act of cutting off an arm without even drawing a sword could only be attributed to magic.
In this world, there is a substance called magical energy that fills the atmosphere, which accumulates in individuals and is referred to as magical power.
The technique to manipulate such magical power is──magic.
“What a hassle.”
I let out a sigh.
While magical energy is abundant in the world, magic itself isn’t something that everyone can use equally.
However, if someone can master it, they become an incredibly troublesome opponent.
In the war-torn Brave Territory, the greatest damage to soldiers and structures was inflicted when facing enemy mages.
Just listening to the foolish story made it clear that they were tactical-grade mages who could use magic without incantation.
Once they reach that level, it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say they are on par with legendary warriors, but why would such a level of individual be sent to Brave Territory?
“It seems they really want to get rid of Alicia.”
Is there some inconvenience, or is it just how the scenario plays out?
Or are they targeting me?
In the game’s story, Alicia not taking over the Brave Family was largely due to my presence.
Did some force intervene to restore the flow that had gone off track?
Or could it be that the cause of Alicia being possessed by a demon was due to these individuals who followed her later, rather than the magic bug?
“Well, I’ll find out if I ask.”
No need for a roundabout way to deal with this.
It’s quicker to scatter them and interrogate them about who sent them.
“Here we go, boom!”
Bang!
As I kicked open the door of the newly established trading company, I found about four men huddled together in a dimly lit room, deep in conversation.
“Wha—!?” “W-Who are you?” “What’s going on here?”
Among the men who hurriedly stood up, one remained seated, appearing calm.
Though his face was hidden beneath a hood, the magical power emanating from him indicated he was a magician.
“Y-You’re Laguna Vel Brave!”
“What are you doing here?”
“What do you mean, what am I doing? You were the ones who made the first move.”
The adventurer who lost his arm was from Brave Territory.
It was his own fault for attempting such a foolish act as stealing, but since they hadn’t stolen anything yet, it was still an attempted crime.
Thus, it was only natural to crack down on such dangerous individuals.
“Made the first move? What are you talking about?”
“We were merely attacked by robbers!”
They insisted that they had been attacked all along.
“Who did what doesn’t matter. The fool who poked the hornet’s nest is just that—a fool.”
As I said this, I threw the adventurer’s severed arm at them.
I didn’t intend to believe everything the foolish adventurer said; I just needed a reason to capture these guys without any hassle and interrogate them.
“For now, you’ll accompany me as important witnesses to the ruckus.”
And now, onto the main topic.
“Also, it seems you’ve been snooping around my territory. If you tell me why, I won’t resort to rough methods.”
As I smiled, their expressions changed as they realized what I was after, and they began to draw weapons from their pockets.
“Armed in front of the lord? That confirms you’re up to no good.”
I gave them a warning, but they continued to grin and chatter among themselves.
“While it may be disrespectful, we won’t just accept being falsely accused of something we didn’t do.”
“Besides, we have the backing of nobility from the Royal Capital. Between the nobility of Discarded Land and those from the Royal Capital, whose words do you think will be believed?”
“Of course, if it’s discovered that we’re armed… which means if we can silence you, there won’t be any problems──!”
The three men, excluding the magician, exchanged glances and raised their weapons to attack.
“At this point, there’s no way to escape responsibility.”
I had thought it would be a hassle if they were the type to talk back, so I was grateful that they were so easily resorting to force.
“Doesn’t matter! Laguna Vel Brave is a target for elimination!”
“You naive third son who came unarmed!”
Oh, really?
“Die! You failed noble of Discarded Land──buh?!”
As the man charged at me while shouting his monologue, I dodged his sword and punched him in the face, making a squelching sound as his face crumpled and teeth flew everywhere.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mjCkmnH.jpeg
Grabbing the sword that fell from the unconscious man’s hand, I swiftly severed the hands of the other two who were holding weapons at the wrists.
“Gahhh!”
“H-Hiiiii!”
As the man who was clutching his wrist screamed and crouched down, I grabbed his hair.
“...Who did you say was the target for elimination?”
“H-Hiiiii!”
In pain and fear, he was unable to respond properly.
To think these were the agents of the Royal Capital; how pathetic.
Brave adventurers wouldn’t act like this even after losing an arm.
“I’ll put off interrogating these guys for now.”
As long as they were desperately holding their wrists, they wouldn’t bleed out and die.
I turned my attention back to the magician, who was clapping his hands in delight.
“You’re wonderful at such a young age of just fifteen!”
“Hah…”
Receiving unexpected praise from the enemy left me speechless.
“So, who hired you, magician?”
“Ku ku ku, there’s no way I’d answer if you asked me.”
“Fair enough.”
I wouldn’t answer either, and I could easily understand that.
If he answered, it would be a stroke of luck, but I’d probably just be left dumbfounded.
Are the magicians from the Royal Capital idiots?
“I have one question I’d like to ask.”
The magician spoke to me with a polite demeanor.
“You said you wouldn’t answer if I asked, yet you’re the one asking?”
“Ku ku ku, then feel free to ignore my question.”
“No, I refuse.”
Even though I clearly rejected him, the magician continued.
“How is Miss Alicia doing?”
“...What do you mean by that?”
I hadn’t intended to engage in pointless banter, but since Alicia’s name came up, I couldn’t help but ask back. The magician grinned widely, exposing his teeth.
“Has she become even more beautiful thanks to my gift? I’m sure she’s been spending her days in pain and agony, with a tortured expression, ku ku ku, kuhihihihi.”
From his mouth, magic bugs spilled out in droves.
“Has the talented Alicia, who was called a genius, fallen into despair, kuhikuhihih.”
With every word he spoke, more and more magic bugs fell from his mouth.
“Imagining her falling apart from a single crack, ku ku ku.”
The fallen magic bugs squirmed at my feet, creating a sight that was increasingly disturbing.
“She’s on the verge of breaking down, kuhi, ee, ee!”
“...So it was you.”
“Ee! It was me! I sent them to her—”
Before the crazed magician could finish his sentence.
──Bang! A loud sound echoed through the air.
“It was youuuuuuuu!!”
The sound came from my foot smashing into the floorboards.
Using magic to propel myself forward, I closed the distance and thrust the sword I held into the magician’s mouth, who was still grinning.
“Fughh!?”
I didn’t feel the sensation of piercing his spine, as the magician managed to turn his head just in time to avoid a fatal injury.
Tch, so close.
As I pinned his cheek against the wall, I shouted into his ear.
“Hey! Day after day after day after day!”
Every single day!
“You’re the one who sent a massive amount of magic bugs to my place!”
What a nuisance!
Even if I got rid of the magic bugs that had possessed Alicia, my windows were still covered with them.
Outside, they stuck to the walls like stink bugs, and inside, they roamed around like cockroaches.
“Honestly, I was getting fed up with it!”
Alicia couldn’t see them, but I could see them clearly.
The days when one would occasionally fall from the ceiling into my coffee, and I would unknowingly drink it only to find a magic bug at the bottom of the cup, made for the worst days ever.
While they didn’t harm me, it was a matter of mood.
“W-What are you talking about...?”
The magician trembled at my sudden outburst.
“Seriously, you’re a real pain in the ass.”
“Ugh, ugh, it hurts, pull out the sword!”
“On top of that, your taste is terrible.”
To imagine a talented woman falling into despair and reveling in it is perverted, isn’t it?
It is indeed perverted.
I would never allow anyone to harbor such feelings toward Alicia.
“By the way, let me teach you something.”
“Agghhh! Ugh, ugh!”
I twisted the sword I had stabbed into him and spoke.
“Alicia has already bounced back and is happily helping with work! She’s a talented woman, so she’s better at it than I am, and she’s more beloved by the staff than I am, living freely with a smile.”
As I said this, the magician’s eyes widened in shock as he glared at me.
“Completely the opposite of what you imagined. Too bad for you, huh?”
“Ahhh! Ugh, ugh, ugh──GamiGiriMuji!”
In a desperate attempt to speak, the magician’s cheek tore open.
As the magician broke free from his restraints and opened his mouth wide, a large bug with sharp jaws crawled out and easily severed the sword that was embedded in the wall.
So this was the magic that had cut off the adventurer’s arm.
This pervert before me was likely a curse specialist, and the invisible curse had resulted in the adventurer losing his arm without realizing it.

There was a wind blade spell in wind attribute magic that could produce a similar effect, but if one had good dynamic vision, they would clearly see it, so there was no way a Brave adventurer would miss it.
“Guh, kuhih? ...A smile?”
The magician mumbled as he swayed.
The torn mouth of his was covered with magic bugs, forming a scab-like appearance as it healed.
“Miss Alicia? After all the gifts I sent her...?”
“There’s no way I’d let something so disgusting reach her.”
The moment she arrived at the Brave Family, I blocked all contact.
Thanks to Onyx’s protection, there would never be another chance for her to receive such messages.
“You won’t reach her anymore; too bad for you.”
“That’s a lie!”
As I clearly stated this, the magician became visibly agitated.
“Her heart is in tatters, and she’s becoming more beautiful! She’s filled with resentment and will gather all her thoughts at the academy!”
The more I listened, the more I realized what a terrible person he was.
But there was good news; it seemed that this guy was the sole culprit behind the magic bugs.
“I don’t believe you! That’s it! I’ll just go see for myself! I’ll go to the mansion right now and tell her directly!”
As the magician shouted, the bug that had extended from his mouth tried to slice me in half with its large jaws.
“Not a chance.”
“Ubororoo!?”
I easily grabbed the bug’s jaws, which had effortlessly severed the iron sword, and dragged it out of the magician’s mouth.
“Let’s talk about the situation; the fact that I can clearly see your disgusting bug and grab it means you’re in trouble, right?”
“W-Why can’t I cut it!? I can easily cut through iron!!”
In front of the astonished magician, I crushed the bug in my hand and replied.
“As long as you don’t understand that, no matter how many curses you send, it won’t work.”
Of course, he wouldn’t be able to send any more.
That’s enough; I don’t have time to deal with this guy.
I focused on the magician as if I were facing enemy soldiers.
“Yikes.”
Time to wrap this up.
“First, this is for our adventurer.”
I picked up the sword that had fallen on the floor and cut off the magician’s right arm.
His screams weren’t worth my attention.
“Next, for sending a massive amount of magic bugs.”
I swiftly severed the remaining limbs to prevent them from sticking together.
Under the pressure of my actions, the magician sat on the chair like a broken doll.
“Why is this happening!? Why is this happening, aaahhh!”
As he flailed his short limbs, I didn’t deny the reality.
It was an undeniable fact.
“If you tell me who’s behind this, I’ll spare your life.”
“I’ll tell you! I’ll tell you! Ignite! Ignite!”
I see, so it was the Ignite family, one of the ducal families in this country.
“Thank you. Now, for the last part, for the harassment against Alicia.”
I beheaded him.
The flicker of hope in the magician’s eyes turned to despair.
With a heavy thud, the magician’s head fell to the floor, facing me.
His mouth moved slightly──cursing me, cursing me, cursing me.
“You’re already cursed.”
I smiled mockingly as I watched the light fade from his eyes.
Before I knew it, the lowly thugs whose wrists I had severed had already breathed their last.
I had obtained the information I wanted, so it didn’t matter anymore.
“Is it over, young master?”
As I stood in a pool of blood, Sebas had quietly appeared behind me.
“It’s done. I’ll leave the cleanup to you.”
“As you wish.”
While I had intentionally gone overboard to extract information, it had been a while since I had acted this ruthlessly, probably since I avenged my family.
I wondered when my heart had become so numb.
At times, I couldn’t tell which version of myself was the real one.
I understood that it was due to my environment, but I still felt like I was in the category of being abnormal.
Hmm… I was a bit anxious about whether I would fit into school life.
